10. The Catamaran’s Ghostly Crew
In the summer of 2002, a former NBA superstar who had changed his name to reflect his heritage set sail from Tahiti on a luxury boat named the Hakuna Matata. Along with his girlfriend and a captain, he vanished into the South Pacific, leaving only his brother—who was later caught trying to sell the athlete’s gold and use his credit cards—as a witness. The brother died by suicide before he could be charged, taking the secret of what happened on that boat to his grave. What was the two-word name this athlete adopted?
